notes: Gathering berries scattered around a garden is a collection loop, which is Adventure's Scavenger Hunt: things to find and pick up across one space. I kept the preset's world-open shape because a bright toon garden is one small contiguous exterior the player wanders freely, and dropped tracker-quest since the answers make the berry total a plain score rather than a posted objective board. alcove-secret stays as the reason finding is an activity at all, with the berries tucked into the planting instead of laid out in the open. Nothing here needs interiors, elevation or separate zones, so it is a plain P0; I took the berries themselves as the payoff and did not add a finish or exit the prompt never implied.
